mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plt_file_artifact (id, name, category_code, owner_context, lifecycle_status_code, invalid_reason_code, invalid_reason_detail, invalidated_at, invalidated_by, version, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, tenant_id) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.name}, #{row.categoryCode}, #{row.ownerContext}, #{row.lifecycleStatusCode}, #{row.invalidReasonCode}, #{row.invalidReasonDetail}, #{row.invalidatedAt}, #{row.invalidatedBy}, #{row.version}, #{row.creator}, COALESCE(#{row.createTime}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)), #{row.updater}, COALESCE(#{row.updateTime}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)), #{row.tenantId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, category_code, owner_context, lifecycle_status_code, invalid_reason_code, invalid_reason_detail, invalidated_at, invalidated_by, version, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, deleted, tenant_id FROM plt_file_artifact WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND id = #{query.artifactId} AND deleted = b'0'

SELECT id, name, category_code, owner_context, lifecycle_status_code, invalid_reason_code, invalid_reason_detail, invalidated_at, invalidated_by, version, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, deleted, tenant_id FROM plt_file_artifact WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND id = #{query.artifactId} AND deleted = b'0' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE plt_file_artifact SET lifecycle_status_code = #{query.targetStatus}, invalid_reason_code = #{query.reasonCode}, invalid_reason_detail = #{query.reasonDetail}, invalidated_at = #{query.occurredAt}, invalidated_by = #{query.actorUserId}, deleted = CASE WHEN #{query.logicalDelete} THEN b'1' ELSE deleted END, version = version + 1, updater = #{query.actorUserId}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND id = #{query.artifactId} AND lifecycle_status_code = #{query.expectedStatus} AND version = #{query.expectedVersion} AND deleted = b'0'
